prompt: Why does this Rectangle/Square design violate LSP?
choices: Square cannot extend Rectangle in Java
Square overrides setWidth/setHeight, breaking code that expects them to be independent
area() returns wrong values for Square
explanation: Code written for Rectangle assumes setting width doesn't change height. Square violates that contract. A method expecting a Rectangle may compute the wrong area when a Square is substituted. LSP requires subtypes to honour the contracts of their supertypes.
